description: A trailing order: a sell follows the market cap up and fires when it falls trail_bps from its high; a buy follows it down and fires when it rises trail_bps from its low. Add twap_slices and twap_interval_s to fill in slices. A buy takes amount in lamports; a sell takes amount in raw token units or holdings_bps of the balance when it fires. paper: true rehearses with real prices and never trades. It lapses after expires_h hours if it hasn't fired. Returns the order with its order_id; follow it with get_order. Signing: fills are signed by this MCP process. If it isn't running when an order fires, the fill is queued and executed on reconnect at the then-current price.

amount.description: a buy: the SOL to spend, in lamports (1 SOL = 1000000000). A sell: raw token units. Give this or holdings_bps

expires_h.description: hours until it lapses if it hasn't fired, default 24

holdings_bps.description: a sell: the share of the wallet's balance when it fires, 10000 = all

paper.description: true: rehearse with real prices; fills are recorded, never signed or traded

side.description: buy spends SOL on the token; sell sells the token for SOL

slippage_bps.description: the most the price may move against a fill, default 300 = 3%

trail_bps.description: how far the market cap must move back from its best to fire: 1000 = 10%

twap_slices.description: fill in this many slices instead of one swap

name: trailing_order
